_comment: Expansion 3 part D.1: level 1 spells of the 2024 Player's Handbook (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md).

ice_knife.name: Ice Knife
ice_knife.text: A shard of ice flung at a foe up to 60 feet away; hit or miss it bursts, and everyone within five feet of it must dodge the cold. Each higher slot adds 1d6 cold.

witch_bolt.name: Witch Bolt

again.name: Witch Bolt: the arc again
again.text: While the spell holds, a bonus action sends the lightning into the same creature again: 1d12, no roll.

witch_bolt.text: A crackling beam binds you to one creature up to 60 feet away (concentration). Each later turn a bonus action burns it again for 1d12, even if the first beam missed. Each higher slot adds 1d12 to the first.

searing_smite.name: Searing Smite
searing_smite.text: Readied on the blade: the next melee hit flares with 1d6 more fire, and the foe burns for 1d6 at the start of each of its turns until it makes a Constitution save. Each higher slot adds 1d6 to both.
